title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SHIPOWNERS' MUTUAL INSURANCE ASSOCIATION ACT

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SHIPOWNERS' MUTUAL INSURANCE ASSOCIATION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Shipowners' Mutual Insurance Association Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Documents to Be Attached to Applications for Registration of Establishment of the Association)
The documents to be attached when applying for registration of establishment of a shipowners' mutual insurance association (hereinafter referred to as the "Association") pursuant to Article 16 of the Shipowners' Mutual Insurance Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be as follows: <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Articles of incorporation;
2. List of members;
3. Applications for membership from each member, where members have been recruited;
4. Investigation reports of directors and auditors and documents annexed thereto;
5. Minutes of the inaugural general meeting;
6. Documents proving acceptance of office by executive officers;
7. Authorization for establishment issued by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

Article 2-2 (Associate Members)
"Maritime-related organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 19-2 (2) of the Act means organizations falling under any of the following subparagraphs: <Amended on Apr. 30, 2018>
1. Incorporated associations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act by overseas transportation business operators under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the International Ship Registration Act;
2. Incorporated foundations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act for development of the shipping industry;
3. Incorporated associations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act by persons registered to engage in tugboat business under Article 32 of the Harbor Act;
4. Incorporated associations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act by pilots under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Pilotage Act;
5. The Korea Marine Environment Corporation under Article 96 of the Marine Environment Management Act;
6. Organizations, other than those specified in subparagraphs 1 through 5, that are corporations established under Article 32 of the Civil Act, have submitted an application for membership to the Association, and have undergone a resolution of the board of directors of the Association.

Article 3 (Scope of Financial Statutes)
"Financial statutes prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 40 (1) 5 and 8 of the Act means the following Acts: <Amended on Mar. 24, 2014; May 31, 2016; Mar. 23, 2021; Feb. 17, 2022; Aug. 23, 2022>
1. The Insurance Business Act;
2. The Banking Act;
3. The Bank of Korea Act;
4. The Depositor Protection Act;
5. The Korea Development Bank Act;
6. The Industrial Bank of Korea Act;
7. Deleted. <Dec. 30, 2014>
8. The Export-Import Bank of Korea Act;
9. The Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act;
10. The Asset-Backed Securitization Act;
11. Deleted. <May 16, 2023>
12. The Industrial Development Act;
13. The Mutual Savings Banks Act;
14. The Specialized Credit Finance Business Act;
15. The Credit Guarantee Fund Act;
16. The Korea Technology Finance Corporation Act;
17. The Credit Unions Act;
18. The Community Credit Cooperatives Act;
19. The Venture Investment Promotion Act;
20. The Credit Information Use and Protection Act;
21. The Act on the Establishment, etc. of the Financial Services Commission;
22. The Agricultural Cooperatives Act;
23. The Fisheries Cooperatives Act;
24. The Foreign Exchange Transactions Act;
25. The Act on the Structural Improvement of the Financial Industry;
26. The Act on Real Name Financial Transactions and Confidentiality;
27. The Financial Holding Companies Act;
28. The Act on the Establishment, etc. of the Korea Asset Management Corporation;
29. The Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information;
30. The Korea Housing Finance Corporation Act;
31. The Financial Consumer Protection Act.

Article 4 (Management of Assets)
(1) The assets of the Association shall be managed in the following ways pursuant to Article 50 of the Act:
1. Acquisition and use of real estate for the business of the Association, such as purchase of business premises;
2. Acquisition and use of government bonds, local government bonds, or securities under Article 4 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act listed on the Korea Exchange under Article 373 of that Act;
3. Deposits with banks under Article 2 of the Banking Act;
4. Entrustment of money or securities to trust business entities under Article 8 (7) of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act.
(2) Where deemed necessary for sound management of the Association's assets, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may determine ratios for each category of asset management under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) or other standards concerning asset management, after consultation with the Financial Services Commission. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(3) Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not apply where the state of the Association's assets changes due to fluctuations in asset prices, enforcement of security interests, or other causes that do not result from a decision of the Association.

Article 5 (Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
(1) The standards for imposition of administrative fines under Article 65 (1) through (3) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table. <Amended on Aug. 19, 2020>
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may reduce the amount of an administrative fine specified in the attached Table by up to one-half, taking into consideration the seriousness and number of violations, the motive for the violation, its consequences, etc. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
